tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Shanghai Masters Friday: Rafael Jodar meets Casper Ruud and Daniil Medvedev faces Tommy Paul in quarterfinals, with Arribage/Olivetti v Cabral/Tracy in the doubles semifinals • WTA Wuhan: Jelena Ostapenko tops Diana Shnaider to reach the quarters; Elina Svitolina–Sonay Kartal and Iga Świątek–Ann Li headline later sessions • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Open finals at the Pyramids: Diego Elías challenges Mostafa Asal after ousting Paul Coll, while Amina Orfi and Hania El Hammamy meet in an all-Egyptian women’s title match • [BADMINTON] VICTOR Denmark Open Day 3: Rasmus Gemke beats Ng Ka Long Angus 21-12, 21-18 and Anders Antonsen rolls past Jason Gunawan as home hopes pack the Odense quarterfinals • [PICKLEBALL] Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open hits pro quarterfinals Friday with noon gates and PickleballTV plus Tennis Channel windows from Virginia Beach • [TABLE TENNIS] ITTF World Hopes Week training continues in Sheffield ahead of the giant round-robin Challenge on Oct. 17–18; WTT Champions Montpellier follows on Oct. 27

newsItems.title: Virginia Beach Quarterfinals
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Tour’s Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open moves into the pro quarterfinals Friday, with gates at noon and PickleballTV coverage all day plus Tennis Channel from 2–5 p.m. ET.

newsItems.title: Egyptian Open Finals Night
newsItems.excerpt: At the Pyramids, Diego Elías faces Mostafa Asal and Amina Orfi meets defending champion Hania El Hammamy to close the CIB Egyptian Open on Friday evening in Giza.

newsItems.title: Hopes Challenge This Weekend
newsItems.excerpt: Thirty-six under-12 prospects from 26 nations wrap intensive training at the ITTF World Hopes Week in Sheffield before the two-day Challenge competition opens Saturday.

newsItems.title: Shanghai QFs & Wuhan QFs
newsItems.excerpt: ATP Shanghai’s Friday card pairs Jodar with Ruud and Medvedev with Paul, while WTA Wuhan’s quarterfinals include Ostapenko’s win over Shnaider plus Svitolina–Kartal and Świątek–Li.
